q2_gaps: Coordination inside an oblique PP ('pays ... in food and shelter'): the default rule for coordinated NPs is to replicate the whole predication once per conjunct, which here would assert two separate paying events; nothing carves out oblique objects to license the two role atoms on one event that the parse (rightly) emits.
Medium-of-payment 'in <goods>' PP: no rule decides between the Instrument role (means) and the preposition-named oblique (In ...) for an in-kind payment phrase.
notes: The shared-constant village plus a rule ranging over (Member $x keeper) is the right existential-over-universal shape, strength 1.0 / confidence 0.9 and the 'each' QuantifierPhrase companion are both correct, and Theme is correctly barred for 'food'/'shelter' since they sit under a preposition.
